first commit

feat: Enhance course-related commands and add deadline management

- Refactored summary command to utilize new course service for file retrieval and improved error handling.
- Introduced tal command to fetch lore about a specific student.
- Updated voice command to include voice session management and improved user feedback.
- Added weather command with student interpretation of temperature.
- Implemented deadline service for managing academic deadlines, including adding and listing deadlines.
- Introduced random events feature to send humorous reminders in a designated channel.
- Added response formatter to customize bot responses based on user persona.
- Created storage utility for managing persistent data files.
- Expanded command list with new food-related commands and improved descriptions for existing commands.
- Updated translations for better clarity and accuracy.
- Implemented voice personality management to enhance user interaction in voice channels.

feat: Enhance command functionalities and error handling

- Updated the monkey command to allow multiple image responses and improved error handling.
- Refactored the noam command to use message constants.
- Improved the ping command with better error handling for reply editing.
- Enhanced the poll command to include duration and multiselect options, with error handling for invalid inputs.
- Added a new random command to generate a random number within a specified range.
- Enhanced the roll command to allow multiple dice rolls and added validation for sides and count.
- Introduced a new serverinfo command to display server details.
- Added a new uptime command to show how long the bot has been active.
- Improved the ticket command to send messages to representatives with error handling.
- Enhanced the weather command to fetch real-time weather data using an external API.
- Added a new userinfo command to display information about a specified user.
- Refactored the commands list to include new options and improved type safety.
- Introduced a new assets utility to manage asset file retrieval.
- Updated messages to include new responses for various commands.
- Removed deprecated command function file to streamline command handling.
